addOnBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开组件时，是否将输入框内容自动创建为标签。
addOnBlur.en-US: Whether the input text becomes a tag when the focus leaves the component.

allowDuplicates.zh-CN: 是否允许添加相同的标签。
allowDuplicates.en-US: Whether the same tag can be added more than once.

aria-label.zh-CN: 输入框的可访问名称，落在输入框上，根节点不带。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the input. It is set on the input, not on the root.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载时是否自动聚焦输入框并激活组件，禁用时不生效。
autofocus.en-US: Whether the input is focused and the component activated on mount; ignored when disabled.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 替换清除按钮中的图标；内容为空时使用默认图标。
clearIcon.en-US: Replaces the icon in the clear button; empty content keeps the default icon.

draggable.en-US: Whether tags can be reordered by dragging.

expandRestTagsOnClick.zh-CN: 不可拖拽时，焦点进入组件（点击、Tab 或 focus 方法）后是否展开被折叠的标签。
expandRestTagsOnClick.en-US: When not draggable, whether the collapsed tags expand once focus enters the component (click, Tab or the focus method).

inputValue.zh-CN: 当前输入框内容，配合 onInputChange 实现受控。
inputValue.en-US: Current input text. Pair it with onInputChange for a controlled input.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签，显示在输入框前；同时提供 prefix 时只显示 prefix。显示时，没有 aria-label、aria-labelledby 的输入框以它命名。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label shown before the input; when prefix is also given, only prefix is shown. When shown, it names an input that has no aria-label or aria-labelledby.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: 内嵌标签容器的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用；未设置时组件自动生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: id of the inset label container, for aria-labelledby; the component generates one when omitted.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 标签的最大展示数量，超出后以 +N 形式展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: Maximum number of tags shown; the rest are shown as +N.

name.zh-CN: 输入框的 name，供表单使用。
name.en-US: The name of the text input, for forms.

onAdd.zh-CN: 添加标签时触发，参数为新增的标签。
onAdd.en-US: Called when tags are added, with the added tags.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个组件时触发一次；焦点在组件内部移动不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Called once when the focus leaves the whole component; moving inside it does not call it.

onChange.zh-CN: 标签变化时触发，参数为完整的标签数组。
onChange.en-US: Called when the tags change, with the whole list of tags.

onExceed.zh-CN: 添加后超过 max 时触发，参数为截断前的完整列表。
onExceed.en-US: Called when adding would exceed max, with the whole list before it is cut.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点从组件外进入时触发一次；焦点在输入框、标签、清除按钮之间移动不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Called once when the focus enters from outside; moving between the input, tags and clear button does not call it.

onInputChange.zh-CN: 输入框内容变化时触发；事件可能是输入事件、KeyboardEvent（Enter 添加）、FocusEvent（addOnBlur）、MouseEvent（清除）或 CompositionEvent（输入法截断），读取专有字段前先按 `event.type` 收窄。
onInputChange.en-US: Called when the input text changes. The event may be an input event, a KeyboardEvent (Enter adds), a FocusEvent (addOnBlur), a MouseEvent (clear) or a CompositionEvent (IME truncation); narrow it by `event.type` before reading its own fields.

onInputExceed.zh-CN: 输入内容超过 maxLength 时触发，参数为被拒绝的输入内容。
onInputExceed.en-US: Called when the input text exceeds maxLength, with the rejected input text.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 输入框按键时在组件处理之后触发；在其中调用 `preventDefault` 不会阻止 Enter 添加标签。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called on keydown in the input after the component handled it; calling `preventDefault` there does not stop Enter from adding a tag.

onRemove.zh-CN: 移除标签时触发，参数为被移除的标签及其序号。
onRemove.en-US: Called when a tag is removed, with the removed tag and its index.

placeholder.zh-CN: 没有标签时输入框的占位文字。
placeholder.en-US: Placeholder of the input while there are no tags.

prefix.zh-CN: 输入框前缀，文字或图标会自动带上左右间隔；自定义元素的左右间隔为 0，可在元素中自行设置。
prefix.en-US: Prefix of the input; text or an icon gets side spacing automatically, while a custom element gets none and can set its own.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内 focus 方法是否阻止浏览器滚动到新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the focus calls inside the component stop the browser from scrolling the focused element into view.

renderTagItem.zh-CN: 自定义标签渲染，返回的元素替换默认标签。第三个参数 onClose 关闭该标签，可直接作为按钮的 `onClick`。
renderTagItem.en-US: Renders each tag with a custom element in place of the default tag. The third argument, onClose, removes that tag and can be passed directly as a button's `onClick`.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: +N 浮层的 Popover 配置属性，可以控制弹出方向、trigger 等；不要传 `content`，它会替换剩余标签的列表。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Popover props of the +N overlay, such as position and trigger. Do not pass `content`: it replaces the list of remaining tags.

separator.zh-CN: 批量输入时的分隔符，可传多个；传 null 不拆分。
separator.en-US: Separator(s) for adding several tags at once; null disables splitting.

showClear.zh-CN: 是否显示一键清除所有标签和输入内容的按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether to show the button that clears all tags and the input text.

showContentTooltip.zh-CN: 标签文字被截断时，hover 标签是否通过浮层显示全部内容；传对象时用 `type` 指定浮层类型（`tooltip` 或 `popover`），用 `opts` 透传给浮层的属性。
showContentTooltip.en-US: Whether hovering a truncated tag shows its full text in an overlay; an object sets the overlay `type` (`tooltip` or `popover`) and passes `opts` to it.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超过 maxTagCount 后，hover 到 +N 时是否通过 Popover 显示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Whether hovering +N shows the remaining tags in a Popover once maxTagCount is exceeded.

split.zh-CN: 自定义分隔符处理函数，参数为原始字符串与 separator，返回拆分后的字符串数组。
split.en-US: Custom split function that receives the raw string and the separator, and returns the split strings.

suffix.zh-CN: 输入框后缀，文字或图标会自动带上左右间隔；自定义元素的左右间隔为 0，可在元素中自行设置。
suffix.en-US: Suffix of the input; text or an icon gets side spacing automatically, while a custom element gets none and can set its own.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，仅影响样式；error 时输入框带 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects styling; error also sets aria-invalid on the input.

value.zh-CN: 当前标签，配合 onChange 实现受控；undefined 时按非受控处理，null 表示受控且没有标签。
value.en-US: Current tags, pair it with onChange for a controlled list; undefined means uncontrolled, null means controlled with no tags.
